referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The captured page begins with a small service/location statement and a large serif practice wordmark balanced against a portrait. A thin, text-led navigation rail follows. The long page shifts through a warm pale-yellow practice statement, alternating treatment-room images and copy, team cards, a ruled services accordion, a specialty feature, split testimonials and photography, and a dark green identity/contact footer. Mobile stacks the image-and-copy chapters and keeps the services list and booking actions touchable. This is a real dental practice and all its actual copy, people, photos, brand, and claims remain reference-only.

acceptanceChecks: The opening balances a short service/location introduction, oversized identity, portrait, and booking action.
Section rhythm alternates statement, image/copy, team, service disclosure, and a distinct dark contact close.
At 390 px the service list and nav remain touch-safe and no horizontal page overflow appears.
Reference screenshots are sourced from the direct official URL, not Lapa's preview or thumbnails.
New site copy and imagery do not reproduce One Manor Place's brand, claims, testimonials, or photos.
